target_customer: Marketing, product, consumer insights and research teams
problem: Surveys and panels are slow and expensive, so only big decisions get validated.
product_category: AI customer twins for market research

competitors.name: Aaru
competitors.traction_then: Series A at $1B headline valuation reported Dec 2025; clients reportedly include Anthropic

competitors.name: Simile
competitors.traction_then: Reported $200M raise at $2B valuation five months after $100M Series A

technical_complexity.rationale: Modeling individuals from interviews with LLMs is accessible, validating accuracy is the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Interview grounded twin data could compound but rivals are far better funded.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded synthetic research rivals already existed; outcome unknown.

market_need_then: Market research is costly and slow; synthetic research drew over $1.5B in venture funding by one estimate.

branding.domain_note: Uses useauxos.com, not the exact auxos.com

brand_strength.rationale: No public brand coverage was found. Confusable with AuxoAI and Auxia.

outcome_analysis: Auxos is a three person Spring 2026 company with no outcome yet. The founders have strong engineering and consulting backgrounds but it competes with Aaru and Simile, which raised far larger rounds. Accuracy proof and enterprise sales will decide it.
notes: Funding unverified: Caplight lists $500K led by YC dated Mar 2026, FundedIQ lists pre-seed June 2026. Kerry Lu is CTO per the launch post, YC page header lists Daniel and Wu. Primary partner David Lieb. The 500K pre-seed round rests on aggregators only (FundedIQ says June 2026, Caplight says March 2026), so the date is recorded as 2026; no press confirmation.
